Description
The Lunar Legends series tells the stories related to each of the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac. 2026 is the Year of the Horse – the 1,000 Mile Horse is a mythical creature of classic Chinese folklore, able to travel one thousand li, or approximately  300 miles, in a single day. This amazing horse was too swift to be mounted by anyone but Bo Le, a famed expert. The 1,000 Mile Horse is captured in 10 ounces of pure silver! A symbol of perseverance and mythical might, it’s a striking addition to any collector’s stable. Housed in a clear capsule each bar is accompanied by a gift envelope. Third issues in the Lunar Legends series.
Each silver bar is packaged in an assay card, which certifies the bar’s weight and silver content.  The assay card also features a unique serial number, adding another layer of security to your investment.
Key Features of the 10 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar Lunar Horse (Envelope, Capsule, New)
Series Theme
: The Horse has been an iconic symbol in various cultures for centuries, from China and Japan to the Middle East & even Europe!
Design Excellence
: The reverse of this silver bar features the intricately detailed image of  the iconic 1000 mile horse. The obverse displays the Displays the PAMP logo, the moon representing lunar! weight and purity along with a unique serial number ensuring its authenticity and quality.
Silver Purity and Weight
: This bar is made of 999 pure silver and weighs 10 oz, making it both a valuable and manageable investment.
Dimensions and Thickness
: The bar measures 52 x 91 mm with a thickness of  7.39 mm, combining elegance with durability.
This silver bar is not just a bullion investment; it’s a piece of art that represents rich cultural heritage and storytelling. It is an ideal choice for collectors, investors, and those who appreciate the deep symbolism. Whether you’re looking to diversify your investment portfolio or seeking a meaningful and auspicious gift, the  10 oz PAMP Suisse Lunar Horse Bar is a remarkable choice.
